data.title: 白井黑子 · 失物袋上的小蝴蝶结
data.description: 支部桌面上摆着刚送来的失物。黑子把一枚蝴蝶结发夹装进透明袋，抬头耐心问你还记不记得在哪里捡到的。
data.promptProse: Kuroko sits at the Judgment branch desk in her beige school vest and brown skirt. She places a ribbon-shaped hair clip into a clear lost-property bag and looks toward the viewer attentively. Daylight from the office window falls over the neatly arranged items.
data.animaCaption: The hair clip is inside the clear bag held above the desk, separate from her own hair ribbons.
data.location: 风纪委员支部的办公桌
data.action: 把蝴蝶结发夹装入透明失物袋
